test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: maths
question: A well with inner radius 3 m, is dug 6 m deep. The soil taken out of it has been spread evenly all around it to a width of 2 m to form an embankment. The height (in m) of the embankment is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Inner radius (r) = 3 m, Depth (h) = 6 m, Embankment Width = 2 m

Outer radius (R) = r + width = 3 + 2 = 5 m

Height of embankment (H) = (r² × h) / (R² − r²)

H = (3² × 6) / (5² − 3²)

H = 54 / (25 − 9) = 54 / 16 = 27 / 8 = 3 3/8 m

**∴ The correct answer is 3 3/8 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Inner radius of well (r) = 3 m

Depth of well (h) = 6 m

Width of embankment = 2 m

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder = π × r² × h

Volume of Embankment (Hollow Cylinder) = π × (R² − r²) × H

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/482cf500c54eca5827de508ce28f6f02ff142ba7fe35c3c3867fdb53a78ea464.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of soil taken out = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume of soil = π × 3² × 6 = 54π m³

⇒ Outer radius of embankment (R) = Inner radius + width = 3 + 2 = 5 m

⇒ Volume of embankment = π × (R² − r²) × H

⇒ Volume of embankment = π × (5² − 3²) × H = π × (25 − 9) × H = 16πH

⇒ Volume of soil = Volume of embankment

⇒ 54π = 16πH

⇒ H = 54 / 16 = 27 / 8

⇒ H = 3 3/8 m

**∴ The correct answer is 3 3/8 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a solid cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Volume of Hollow Cylinder (Embankment)

The volume of a hollow cylinder is the difference between the volumes of the outer and inner cylinders: V = π(R² − r²)h.

Conservation of Volume

When an object is reshaped (like soil from a hole used to build a platform), the total volume remains constant.</p
